hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tests/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/workers/*) case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" ;; esac ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
